label: Inline
description: Inline emoji picker. Best for the panel on its own, always open on a card and holding one controlled value with no button.

label: Chat Composer
description: Chat composer. Best for a bubble thread that scrolls to each send, with an emoji button beside the message field that stays open for several picks.

label: Message Reactions
description: Message reactions. Best for reaction pills split by skin tone with counts, plus a row of 6 one tap reactions placed above the search.

label: Page Icon
description: Page icon. Best for a large stored emoji that is its own button, swapping to an Add icon button once removed, echoed in the breadcrumb.

label: Custom Team Emoji
description: Custom team emoji. Best for image emoji in a team section placed ahead of Frequently used, stored as colon codes and drawn back as images.

label: Shortcode Suggestions
description: Shortcode suggestions. Best for a list of 5 ranked matches under a text box as a colon code is typed, plus an instant swap of a closed colon code.

label: Workplace-Safe Set
description: Workplace-safe set. Best for a picker without nature, food, travel or flags for a text box that spaces each pick off its neighbours, with Undo after posting.

label: Localized Labels
description: Localized data and labels. Best for a language switch that swaps the emoji data and the picker's labels, and clears the search.
